picks.editorial_note: Purdue lands two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards, a flagship national initiative putting AI at the center of scientific discovery — including organizing data streams from the Electron-Ion Collider. A strong signal of where federal AI research priorities and dollars are heading.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's £20m MRC-funded Hub pairs stem-cell tissue models with AI to speed up drug development — a major, well-funded bet on AI accelerating preclinical medicine.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's Jason Zhang is using generative AI to design entirely novel proteins not found in nature, extending Nobel laureate David Baker's computational protein engineering work — a genuine scientific frontier with biotech implications.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: Hebrew University's Haim Sompolinsky wins the 2026 Dirac Medal for foundational statistical-mechanics work underpinning modern AI theory — top-tier international recognition of AI's scientific roots.
picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal

picks.editorial_note: HKU-led RoboDojo, built with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes the first unified benchmark for embodied AI robot manipulation — a new global standard likely to shape robotics research worldwide.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: SRI, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Florida are building an ARPA-H-funded AI system to guide healthcare workers through procedures like blood draws and intubation — a concrete academia-industry-government partnership with direct clinical impact.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside secures DOE Genesis Mission Phase I funding to apply AI to quantum computing error correction and national-lab data sharing, another concrete win from the same major federal AI initiative.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Tsinghua's 'GeoPT' teaches AI models physical reasoning from efficient simulations rather than costly real-world data — a notable methodological advance for physically grounded AI.
picks.title: With a feel for physics, AI models simulate a wider range of real-world scenarios

picks.editorial_note: A university-born startup, FastFlowLM, joining AMD shows academic AI research translating directly into industry adoption, with the team's NPU-optimization software now backed by a major semiconductor player.
picks.title: URI professors’ startup team joined semiconductor giant AMD

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama and Fermilab win DOE Genesis Mission Phase 1 funding to build AI tools for sifting massive particle-physics datasets, extending the national initiative's reach into fundamental physics.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project
